rationale: Read complete driver and current cap/copy implementations. Six syntactically checked in-memory copy removals feed eight product paths across two variants. This is a useful historical measurement harness, not a passing regression suite: no result assertion exists. Current baseline transform rejects check-job-log-tail-slice because sanitization now owns copying; no current measurements claimed. Preserve archive unchanged.

cases.title: github-long-line fixed=False: eight independent large inputs
cases.reason: Manual measurement calls actual cap/excerpt/queue APIs with independent synthetic prefixes, retains returned strings, clears legacy RegExp root and records logical length/UTF-8 bytes/forced-GC heap delta. There are no content, cap, parity or heap-threshold assertions in this driver.
